parameters.query: INSERT INTO prospects (name, title, company, email, linkedin_url, decision_maker_score, company_size, pain_points, approach_angle, industry, enriched_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.original.name }}', '{{ $json.original.title }}', '{{ $json.original.company }}', '{{ $json.original.email }}', '{{ $json.original.linkedin_url }}', {{ $json.enrichment.decision_maker_score }}, '{{ $json.enrichment.company_size }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.enrichment.pain_points) }}', '{{ $json.enrichment.approach_angle }}', '{{ $json.enrichment.industry }}', NOW()) ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET decision_maker_score = EXCLUDED.decision_maker_score, enriched_at = NOW() RETURNING *
